data.name: Price Ki Azaadi (Freedom From Price Hikes)
data.headline: Freedom from price hikes. Lock your 2028 renewal at 2027 prices.
data.benefit: Freedom from price hikes: buy an annual over Freedom Weekend (13–17 Aug) and get 20% off, 15 extra days, and your 2028 renewal locked at 2027 prices. Only 47 in Mumbai, 19 in Bengaluru.
data.rationale: A price lock costs nothing in 2027 and answers the renewal-price objection a year early. It sells the annual on certainty, not depth, and every lock is a 2028 renewal already in the book.
data.audience: Members and returning clients; annual renewers due Aug–Nov.
data.conditions: Annual cap 25% (20% cash + 15 days ≈ 24.1%). Price lock applies to the next annual renewal only. 47 / 19 memberships.

scenes.title: Squad Goals, Squat Goals

data.name: Squad Goals, Squat Goals
data.headline: Your squad. Our studio. Matching socks, obviously.
data.benefit: Squad goals, squat goals: book a free Squad Class for up to 4 friends who’ve never been. If they join, they get 15% off and friendship-band grip socks, and you get 5 extra days for each one.
data.rationale: Referrals convert at 22–76%; friends who start together come together. A free group class lowers the bar for the nervous friend, and the member is paid only when someone buys.
data.conditions: Friends must be new to P57 (phone verified). Member reward max 15 days. Standard 15% for friends only.

scenes.title: No Strings Attached
scenes.narration: New clients: No Strings Attached. Commitment issues? Same. 15 buyers at 16,204 rupees — 2.43 lakh rupees. 20 per cent off.

data.name: No Strings Attached
data.headline: Commitment issues? Same. Here’s a membership with a break-up clause.
data.benefit: Commitment issues? Same. Try 2 classes for ₹999, and if you join, the ₹999 comes off your first month. And if it’s not for you after two weeks, we turn what’s left into a class pack. No strings. Well, one: show up.
data.rationale: Clients with 5+ visits in month one buy again at 93.5%. A break-up clause costs almost nothing (few use it) and answers the objection the desk hears most: “what if I can’t keep it up?”.
data.conditions: One per phone number. Credit within 72 hours of class 2; the switch must be requested within 14 days of the start date. Standard 15% only.
data.offerType: Newcomer intro with a break-up clause

scenes.title: Freedom to Pause (Not Quit)
scenes.narration: Renewals: Freedom to Pause (Not Quit). Freedom to pause, not quit. 24 buyers at 42,000 rupees — 10.1 lakh rupees. 19.6 per cent off.

data.name: Freedom to Pause (Not Quit)
data.headline: Pause for Ganpati. Pause for Diwali. Just don’t quit.
data.benefit: Freedom to pause, not quit: renew for 3 months at 15% and get 2 Freedom Freezes for festive travel, or 6 months with a private and 3 freezes. Go home for Ganpati. Come back to your spot.
data.rationale: Members lapse in Sep–Nov when travel breaks the habit. A freeze keeps them paying and coming back instead of cancelling; freezes have no cash cost, so the cash discount stays at the standard 15%.
data.conditions: 3M 15% / 6M 19.6% effective (private at list; freezes have no cash value). Freezes expire 30 Nov.
data.kpi: Renewal yield vs Aug-26; Sep–Nov lapse rate of August renewers.

scenes.title: 4 moves
scenes.narration: First, Set up No Strings Attached in Momence. Then, Weekly check: No Strings Attached: Trial to member target 35%.

steps.label: W1
steps.text: Set up No Strings Attached in Momence (2027-08-01 to 2027-08-21): Mumbai: 2 classes in 7 days for ₹999 (any format), credited against 1 Month at the standard 15% bought within 72 hours (₹16,204 net). Kenkere: 2 Barre classes for ₹709, credited the same way (₹11,697 net). Pop-ups: paid trial (≈₹945) → 8-class pack at 15% (₹5,891). The No-Strings clause: in the first 14 days of the month, if it is not for you, the desk converts what is left into an 8-class pack (60 days). No break-up fee, no awkwa

steps.label: W2
steps.text: Weekly check: No Strings Attached: Trial → member (target 35%); No-Strings switches (expect <10%). | Price Ki Azaadi (Freedom From Price Hikes): Annuals sold (target 8 Mumbai, 1 Bengaluru); 2028 locks. | Squad Goals, Squat Goals: Squad Classes booked; friend → purchase (target 30%). | Freedom to Pause (Not Quit): Renewal yield vs Aug-26; Sep–Nov lapse rate of August renewers.

steps.label: W3
steps.text: Mid-month review against ₹25.5L: by the 15th aim for ~half of 82 new buyers (380 first visits), 60 renewals and 42 winbacks. Push the lists, not a deeper discount.

steps.label: W4
steps.text: Close August: tag every redemption by offer ID (O27-xx), log trial attendance and trial→purchase per offer, brief next month.
